title: Improved Cryopreservation of Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell (iPSC) and iPSC-derived Neurons Using Ice-Recrystallization Inhibitors
study_design: Primary comparison of N-aryl-D-aldonamide ice-recrystallization inhibitors added to mFreSR for iPSCs or CryoStor10 (CS10) for terminally differentiated iPSC-Ns, with viability, recovery, pluripotency, and neuronal-function endpoints.

experiments.model: HAF-iPSCs frozen in mFreSR alone or supplemented with IRIs
experiments.intervention: IRI dose screen followed by focus on 2FA
experiments.cooling: −1 °C/min in 1 mL cryovials; 1 week storage before thawing
experiments.storage: −80 °C for 24–48 h then liquid nitrogen for long-term experiments; 1 week for initial dose screen
experiments.outcome_name: Trypan-blue post-thaw viability and 48 h proliferation/recovery
experiments.timepoint: immediate post-thaw viability; 48 h post-thaw confluence
experiments.result: 0.5 mM 4ClA, 10 mM 2FA, and 15 mM PMA produced the highest reported viabilities (71%, 71.5%, and 74.5%); 10 mM 2FA reached 65.0% confluence at 48 h versus 47.6% mFreSR control. The figure reports n=3 for viability and confluence comparisons.
experiments.sample_size: n=3 for plotted comparisons; confluence averaged 9 images per well across triplicate conditions
experiments.source_locator: Results, ‘Post-thaw Viability of iPSCs’ and ‘2FA Improves Post-thaw Recovery’; Fig. 1a-c
experiments.evidence_excerpt: the highest percent viability was observed for 0.5 mM 4ClA (71%), 10 mM 2FA (71.5%), and 15 mM PMA (74.5%)

experiments.model: Terminally differentiated iPSC-Ns at approximately 63 days in neuronal maturation medium
experiments.intervention: 2FA added to CS10 at 2.5, 5, or 10 mM
experiments.outcome_name: Post-thaw neuronal network activity, synaptic function, markers, and viability
experiments.timepoint: post-thaw functional recovery; viability endpoint not quantitatively improved
experiments.result: 2FA did not significantly improve iPSC-N post-thaw viability, but 2FA-cryopreserved neurons re-established neuronal network activity and synaptic function earlier than CS10 controls and retained neuronal markers and pharmacological responses.
experiments.source_locator: Abstract; Methods, iPSC-N cryopreservation; Results, neuronal functional characterization
experiments.evidence_excerpt: 2FA cryopreserved iPSC-Ns re-established robust neuronal network activity and synaptic function much earlier compared to CS10 cryopreserved controls.

main_finding: 2FA improved HAF-iPSC viability/recovery and preserved or accelerated functional recovery of cryopreserved iPSC-derived neurons, despite no significant iPSC-N viability improvement.
limitations: Replicate counts and exact functional timepoints for the neuronal assays were not located in the extracted text summary.
Routine 10 µM ROCK inhibitor was used in post-thaw iPSC culture, so iPSC recovery comparisons include that recovery background.
mechanism_claim: IRI activity is the directly tested physical-ice axis; earlier neuronal function is an observed outcome, while a direct biological pathway mechanism is not established.
